picks.why: Demonstrates the egg and seasoned panko dredging setup, oil spraying for golden color, and spacing tenders in the air fryer basket.
Demonstrates patty dimpling to prevent puffing, spacing patties in the air fryer basket, and topping with cheese under residual heat.
Demonstrates seasoning salmon fillets skin-side down, air frying without flipping, and testing for flaky doneness.
Shows the two-spatula smash and the 30-second sear that gets the lacy crust.
Shows slicing chicken and peppers into uniform strips and spreading them across the sheet pan so they roast rather than steam.
Shows seasoning the split wings, crisping them in the air fryer basket, and tossing them in melted garlic butter and parmesan cheese.
Demonstrates browning 85/15 ground beef in the skillet, breaking it into crumbles, and simmering with spices until glazed.
Shows cubing sirloin steak into uniform bites, tossing in seasoning, and air frying in a single layer for a quick sear.
Demonstrates cutting uniform sausage coins and potatoes, spreading them flat on a sheet pan, and roasting until crisp.
Demonstrates tilting the cast iron skillet to spoon foamy butter, garlic, and herbs continuously over the searing steak.
Shows pressing pork chops into the parmesan-panko coating, arranging them in the air fryer, and cooking until golden and crisp.
Demonstrates flash searing shrimp in a hot skillet with butter and garlic before finishing off-heat with fresh lemon juice.
Chef John demonstrates browning pork with aromatics and quickly wilting cabbage in the skillet so it retains crispness.
Shows air frying drumsticks until crispy before brushing with BBQ sauce for a quick caramelizing glaze.
Demonstrates arranging salmon fillets alongside trimmed green beans on a sheet pan for an even 400°F roast.
Shows oiling and salting whole russet potatoes, air frying for crispy skin, and opening the steamy fluffy interior.
Demonstrates two-tier layering of tortilla chips, seasoned beef, and cheese on a sheet pan to prevent soggy chips.
Demonstrates arranging frozen potstickers in a single layer, oil spraying to prevent wrapper dryness, and air frying until crispy.
Demonstrates the complete 3-2-1 method: smoking for bark, wrapping in foil with butter to tenderize, and finishing with BBQ glaze.
Chef John demonstrates browning ground beef, blooming the chili spices directly in the rendered fat, and simmering with beans.
